info.name: Foodify API — Customer Authentication v1
info.description: Manual Postman collection for the FastAPI customer phase. Import one of the development/test/production environment templates, fill its values locally, then send requests one at a time. No tests, assertions, pre-request or post-response scripts are included. Tokens and IDs must be copied manually. API prefix: /api/v1; health routes have no prefix. Read README.md and docs/FUNCTIONS.md for flow and security behavior. Production URL is a placeholder and no production requests have been sent. OAuth callback request is reference-only and is normally executed by the provider in a browser.

request.description:
REFERENCE ONLY: the provider redirects the browser here; do not manually fabricate code/state. Valid callback returns 303 to FRONTEND_URL/oauth/callback#ticket=... or #error=email_verification_required. The frontend is outside this backend repository. Copy the fragment ticket to oauth_ticket; never enter provider tokens here. The callback state and code are single-use.

Expected success: HTTP 303. All errors use the documented error envelope.

Within two minutes, exchange the callback ticket plus the ORIGINAL verifier used to compute the start challenge. The ticket is single-use. Manually copy access_token and refresh_token afterward; add phone/address via customer endpoints.

Expected success: HTTP 200. All errors use the documented error envelope.

response.name: 200 example
